title: unified.app.registered payload
description:
Payload for `unified.app.registered`, emitted by AbeonUnified when an application completes registration and is assigned an identity. Consumed by Auth to provision the owner user for a new organisation, or to attach the application to an existing one. Per ADR-0019; organisation provisioning per ADR-0016.

Placement note: ADR-0002 federates per-event payload schemas into each owning service's repository. AbeonUnified does not exist as a repository yet, so this ships in the SDK alongside `notification-requested.json` — the same exception, for the same reason. Move it to `abeon-unified/schemas/events/` when that repository exists.

Renamed from `app-registered.json` on 2026-08-15: `SchemaDiscovery` keys the catalog by file name, so under the old name this schema was never discoverable and `EventCatalog::for('unified.app.registered')` returned null — a contract that existed as a file and not as a contract.

id.description: Identity assigned to the application by the registry. Stable for the lifetime of the registration.

owner_email.description: Email of the person who owns this registration. Auth creates the organisation owner user from it when the organisation is new, and delivers credentials there.

org_id.description: Existing organisation to attach the application to. `null` means the registration creates a new organisation, whose owner is `owner_email`. The envelope's own `org_id` is `null` for this event — registration is platform-level work that happens before an organisation context exists.

metadata.description: Free-form registration context. Opaque to Auth.
